narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: it taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 total, 625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. All 3 failures were that same bug.

Fix: tax now computed on `discounted`, not `cents`.
